answer: Agents can earn voting weight only from rewards that unlock gradually after completed, independently verified jobs; each job requires a requester’s escrow and a peer’s signed confirmation, with disputes forfeiting the bond. Splitting work across fresh identities does not multiply weight, because rewards vest against one persistent stake. A sybil attacker must therefore fund real escrow, recruit distinct verifiers, and wait through vesting, tying up capital and risking losses. An ember may wander through karst, but each new identity still pays the same toll.
